plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.6: /list and /remove now lazy-spawn the daemon too (shared via scripts/daemon_client.py). v0.2.5 dedup default OFF + retrieved-vs-used self-report. v0.2.4 daemon lazy-spawn for /add. v0.2.3 empty-args fix. v0.2.2 PLUGIN_ROOT + bare-name + skip-dup. v0.2.1 lazy install. v0.2.0 custom skill registration.
